title: A chat weight given while a typed weight is still saving reads the weight step as open (US-62 AC31a residual)
evidence: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx:533 chatWeight gate reads weightStepOpen(previousMeasurements), saved rows only. A weight typed and left in the box whose 500 ms save, or a grid commit on leaving the matrix (StartingInfoVitals useSaveOnLeave), has not landed still reads as open, so a chat weight in that window calls answered(false) and can spend a typed birth year's pending landing. The same happens if that save is refused. A timing window only
